requirements.evidence: Contract is fully present: `app/Models/Entity.php:14` (`#[Fillable(['name','slug'])]`), `:23` (`getRouteKeyName()` returns 'slug'), `:51` (`owner()` filtered on the owner role); `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12,21,47` (fillable, role cast, owner/admin/employee scopes); `app/Models/UserRole.php:7,16` (`Owner/Admin/Employee`, `manageable() === [Admin, Employee]`); `app/Models/User.php:23,31,41` (memberships/entities/membershipFor). Migrations: `database/migrations/2026_10_29_042706_create_entities_table.php:17,19` (slug unique via `entities_slug_unique`, soft deletes) and `..._create_entity_memberships_table.php:16,18,19-21,24-31` (cascade FKs, role default 'employee', stored generated `owner_seq`, both named unique indexes). Policies match the role matrix (`app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:15,23,31,39,47`, `app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:14,22,31-40`). Tenant flow: `app/Http/Middleware/ResolveCurrentEntity.php:26-50` (session entity + 403, 0/1/>1 dispatch), `app/Http/Controllers/HomeController.php:11-13`, `app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:19-25` (policy check, session untouched on 403, audit log), `app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:26-70` (validate, owner forced server-side, retry loop, audit log, session, redirect) with `uniqueSlug()` overridable at `:82-89`, and `app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:14,19` (locked entity + view authorization). Switcher (`resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:6-13`), navbar link (`resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php:14`), routes (`routes/web.php:22-42`), and both locales (`lang/pt_BR/ui.php:50-52`, `lang/en/ui.php:50-52`) are all in place. No out-of-scope feature (members/settings) was built.

conventions.evidence: Follows the important ones: Livewire uses `#[Validate]` + `$this->validate()` and authorizes server-side (`app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:21,26,28`), server-only model is `#[Locked]` (`app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:14`), persistent middleware is registered (`app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:20`), migrations are generator-style with reversible `down()` (`..._create_entity_memberships_table.php:37-41`), `$fillable` is deliberate (`app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12`), Blade components are reused (`x-form-field`, `x-button`, `x-layouts::default-page`) and `{{ }}` escaping is used. Docs are kept in sync (`docs/database-schema.md`, `docs/architecture.md:136`, `CHANGELOG.md`). Deviations: the entity-creation domain write lives inline in the component instead of an `app/Actions/*` class (`app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:34-70`), and the switcher is a route closure with an inline Eloquent query (`routes/web.php:30-34`).

security.evidence: No weakness found. `entity.pick` authorizes through the policy before writing the session (`app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:19`), the tenant middleware aborts 403 for a session entity the user does not belong to (`app/Http/Middleware/ResolveCurrentEntity.php:33`) and never trusts the route entity for tenant scope. Dashboard authorizes `view` on the route-bound, `#[Locked]` model (`app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:14,19`). Onboarding validates input (`CreateEntity.php:21,26`), authorizes creation (`:28`) and hardcodes the creator's `owner` role (`:44-46`), so no client input can change it. Mass assignment is bounded by explicit `#[Fillable]` lists (`Entity.php:14`, `EntityMembership.php:12`), CSRF is present on the switcher form (`resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:7`), all output is escaped (`{{ $entity->name }}` at `:10,12`), and no secrets are placed on public Livewire properties.

tests.evidence: Strong, meaningful coverage: policy role matrix (`tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:101-135`), DB-level second-owner and duplicate-membership rejection (`:73-88`), cascade (`:90`), onboarding validation/owner/slug/retry/audit/soft-deleted-slug (`tests/Feature/EntityOnboardingTest.php:48,59,80,97,107,124`), guests and unverified redirects (`tests/Feature/EntityTenantTest.php:11,24`), home dispatch, 403 on foreign entity, session untouched on forbidden pick, switcher markup and navbar visibility (`:31-105,118,144,166`), and both locales. Gaps: the test named 'picking an entity stores the session, logs audited and redirects' (`tests/Feature/EntityTenantTest.php:118`) never asserts the audit log, and there is no tamper attempt on the Dashboard's `#[Locked]` entity property.

simplicity.evidence: Lean overall: reuses the existing layout, `x-form-field`/`x-button`, Laravel's FK/unique features and policy auto-discovery; no service/repository layer; the retry loop is the minimum needed for the specified race (`app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:34-58`). Minor duplication: `EntityPolicy.php:53-63` and `EntityMembershipPolicy.php:45-54` repeat the membership/role helpers, and the tenant context is stored twice (`ResolveCurrentEntity.php:60-61`: request attribute plus container instance).

readability.evidence: Clear names and short, documented methods throughout (`ResolveCurrentEntity.php:18-63`, `EntityPolicy.php:15-63`, `CreateEntity.php:24-89`); the generated-column expression is explained in docs. Minor friction: `submit()` carries validation, authorization, the transaction/retry loop and side effects in ~45 lines, and `uniqueSlug()` pre-increments `$suffix` before use (`CreateEntity.php:82-89`). The navbar adds a `memberships()->count()` query on every authenticated page (`resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php:14`).

scope.evidence: Everything serves the task: models/enum/policies/migrations/factories/components/routes/lang under `app/`, `database/`, `resources/views/`, `routes/web.php`, `lang/*`, plus the required docs (`docs/database-schema.md`) and changelog entry (`CHANGELOG.md:9`). No members page, settings page, dashboard-to-settings links, locale middleware, navbar redesign or centering change was added; the `docs/business-rules.md:4` and `docs/architecture.md` edits only record the newly implemented tenant/entity model.

issues.explanation: The test 'picking an entity stores the session, logs audited and redirects' never asserts the audit log, so the `entity.pick` audit requirement (`app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:23`) is effectively untested despite the test name.
No tamper test attempts to overwrite the `#[Locked]` `$entity` property, which the Livewire definition of done explicitly asks for; only route-level 403s are covered.
Entity creation is a domain write performed inline in the Livewire component, whereas the convention routes domain writes through an `app/Actions/*` class that authorizes internally.
The switcher page is a route closure doing the Eloquent query inline, unlike the other entity routes that use a controller or Livewire component.
The navbar runs a `memberships()->count()` query on every authenticated page render; it could reuse an already-loaded relation or a cached count.
The old `view('home')` consumer is replaced but the diff does not remove the now-unused `resources/views/home.blade.php`, leaving an orphaned view behind.

review.summary: The change implements the entity/membership data model, database-level single-owner constraint, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding with slug retry, switcher, navbar entry and minimal dashboard, with good docs and test coverage. It is behaviorally faithful to the task and security-conscious; the remaining findings are test gaps (pick audit assertion, locked-property tamper), one conventions deviation (inline domain write instead of an Action) and small nits, so it is approvable with minor changes.
